key_insight: Solution-phase ligand exchange enables thicker AgBiS2 near-infrared absorbers for tandem photovoltaics, delivering 24.0% efficiency in a four-terminal tandem.
engineering_relevance: Improved charge extraction in thicker nanocrystal films supports scalable AgBiS2 integration with visible-light-absorbing perovskite sub-cells.
method: Model tandem performance using the measured AgBiS2 absorption spectrum.
Use solution-phase ligand exchange for one-step deposition of passivated nanocrystals.
Fabricate four-terminal and monolithic tandems with lead-halide perovskite sub-cells.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 24.0% four-terminal tandem efficiency, voltage addition in monolithic tandems, and >90% efficiency retention after three months of unencapsulated dry-air storage.
watch_item: The >47.9% triple-junction efficiency is a modeled projection, while dry-air storage stability does not establish durability under operating conditions.
paper_title: Stable AgBiS2 near-infrared absorbers for thin film tandem photovoltaics
